scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide city street with tall buildings on both sides, lined with trees and featuring a mix of commercial and residential properties. The street is relatively empty, with only a few vehicles parked along the curb.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings on either side of the street are primarily two to three stories high, with a mix of modern and traditional facades. Some have balconies, while others feature large windows and ornate details.
scene_analysis.materials: The street is paved with asphalt, with white lines marking the lanes and pedestrian crossings. The sidewalk is made of concrete, with some sections featuring decorative planters and tree-lined medians.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and bike racks along the sidewalk, as well as a few trash cans and recycling bins.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The street is lined with tall trees that provide shade and add to the aesthetic appeal of the area. There are also some potted plants and hanging baskets adding color and texture.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs visible, including directional signs, business names, and informational signs. Some of the signs are mounted on poles, while others are attached to the buildings.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: There are no pedestrians visible in the immediate vicinity, although there may be some distant activity.
scene_analysis.lighting_atmosphere: The lighting is soft and diffused, with a warm glow emanating from the streetlights and building windows.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The street appears to be a quiet, residential area, with a few residents visible in the distance. There are also some outdoor seating areas and cafes, suggesting a lively atmosphere during the day.
scene_analysis.as_commuter: The street is not heavily trafficked, with only a few cars and bicycles visible. There are some pedestrians walking in the distance, but the area is generally peaceful.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The street is not particularly touristy, but there are some interesting architectural details and unique features that might attract visitors.
scene_analysis.as_student: The street is relatively quiet, with only a few students visible in the distance. There are some outdoor seating areas and cafes, suggesting a lively atmosphere during the day.
